name: Jean-Pierre Wimille
features: olive skin, dark hair combed back, dark heavy-lidded eyes, square face, strong jaw, broad-shouldered athletic build, quietly assured expression
bio: Le Mans winner in 1937 and 1939, both times in a Bugatti Tank, and widely held to be the quickest man in Europe by the end of the decade. He flew for the Armée de l’Air, then ran weapons and radios for the Chestnut resistance circuit alongside Grover-Williams and Benoist. Post-war he was untouchable for Alfa Romeo, and was killed practising for the 1949 Buenos Aires Grand Prix.
